info.name: HIMS patient treatment details
info.description: Read-only live check of KRJ HIMS. Defaults to hospital 5, branch 1, 2026-10-15. No credentials were required during the 2026-10-24 check. Assertions follow the observed response structure, not an official vendor contract. The date range applies to TestMastVMs[].Adddate; Appdate can differ. Responses contain patient data: avoid exporting or sharing response bodies. CLI: postman collection run examples/hims.postman_collection.json --timeout-request 30000 --ignore-redirects --no-report-events. Override parameters with --env-var fromDate=YYYY-MM-DD and --env-var toDate=YYYY-MM-DD.

request.description: GET with no body. Patient records contain nested TestMastVMs treatment arrays. Empty result arrays are permitted for dates with no data.

exec: if (!/^[1-9]\d*$/.test(String(pm.variables.get(key)))) throw new Error(key + ' must be a positive integer');
if (!/^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/.test(value) || !Number.isFinite(parsed.getTime()) || parsed.toISOString().slice(0, 10) !== value) throw new Error(key + ' must be a valid YYYY-MM-DD date');
if (pm.variables.get('fromDate') > pm.variables.get('toDate')) throw new Error('fromDate must be on or before toDate');
pm.test('Response is a JSON array', () => { rows = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(Array.isArray(rows)).to.equal(true); });
const object = value => value !== null && typeof value === 'object' && !Array.isArray(value);
const hasId = value => (typeof value === 'number' && Number.isFinite(value)) || (typeof value === 'string' && value.trim().length > 0);
pm.test('Records contain patient and transaction IDs and treatment arrays', () => {
const treatments = rows.flatMap(row => object(row) && Array.isArray(row.TestMastVMs) ? row.TestMastVMs : []);
pm.test('Treatments contain treatment IDs', () => pm.expect(treatments.every(row => object(row) && hasId(row.Treatmentid))).to.equal(true));
pm.test('Treatments match requested hospital', () => pm.expect(treatments.every(row => object(row) && String(row.Hospitalid) === String(pm.variables.get('hospitalId')))).to.equal(true));
pm.test('Treatments match requested branch', () => pm.expect(treatments.every(row => object(row) && String(row.Branchid) === String(pm.variables.get('branchId')))).to.equal(true));
pm.test('Treatment Adddate values fall within requested dates', () => {
return Number.isFinite(parsed.getTime()) && parsed.toISOString().slice(0, 10) === date && date >= from && date <= to;
console.log('HIMS summary: ' + rows.length + ' records, ' + treatments.length + ' treatments; ' + pm.response.responseTime + ' ms');
